name: Magliano de' Marsi (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Magliano de' Marsi (a figure before mountains beneath a maroon chief) within branches, with the inscription Comune di Magliano de' Marsi in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Magliano de' Marsi, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 18 March 1936.

features.role: Magliano de' Marsi arms — figure before mountains beneath a maroon chief, crowned, within branches
inscription Comune di Magliano de' Marsi beneath the arms
